summary: Property exclusion (Ed 2026-11-18). Adds properties.excluded_at + excluded_reason (both or neither); v_current_property_owners leaves excluded rows out (mailings, statements, owner lists). Marks one row: the Lakes of Pine Forest phantom 17914 Windy Orchard Lane (Vantaca 2012694, no county parcel), so LOPF counts and bills 542 homes. Nothing deleted; ownership, tenures and transactions unchanged.

preflight.name: the phantom property is present and not yet excluded
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM properties WHERE id = 'abc07cff-0578-4fd2-a2fb-3781bbc1b9a5' AND street_address = '17914 Windy Orchard Lane' AND vantaca_account_id = '2012694'

preflight.name: LOPF has 543 property rows before
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM properties WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002'

preflight.name: 17914 Old Forest Lane (2012698) present
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM properties WHERE street_address = '17914 Old Forest Lane' AND vantaca_account_id = '2012698'

expected_changes: properties gains excluded_at and excluded_reason (nullable, paired by a check), plus a partial index on included rows.
v_current_property_owners: same columns, now WHERE excluded_at IS NULL.
One property row marked excluded (17914 Windy Orchard Lane). No rows added or deleted.

verify.name: exactly one property excluded
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM properties WHERE excluded_at IS NOT NULL
